text:
Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
7:02 PM

Aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Core i5/i7 chip, and you'll get a smooth programming laptop under ₹80,000.

RAM: 16 GB is the sweet spot. 8 GB gets tight with a browser, editor and Android Studio or Docker open. Pick one that can be upgraded later.
Chip: Ryzen 5/7 (H or U series) or Intel Core i5/i7 from the last two years. An Apple M-series Air is great for battery and quiet use if you can find one in budget.
Storage: 512 GB SSD at least.
Screen: Full HD or better, matte if possible, and a keyboard you like typing on for hours.
Skip: A dedicated graphics card, unless you'll train AI or play games. It adds weight and cost and cuts battery life.

I haven't checked live prices, so I can't name exact laptops yet. What will you mostly build: web or apps, AI work, or a bit of everything?
